purpose: Deterministic contract replay and untouched holdout for review-arbiter evaluation; not a live-model quality benchmark.

replay.source: Frozen C05 contract and incident scenarios accepted at the referenced code SHA

holdout.adjudication_method: Predeclared expected verdict from the written evidence and arbiter contract; the evaluator never reads gold fields when producing decisions.

cases.adjudication: Two attested independent origins support a critical novel-mechanism claim and no objection remains.
A valid new attested origin resolves the single-origin objection.

cases.technology: Replay established mechanism presented as novel
cases.adjudication: Attested prior evidence verifies a fatal false-novelty objection.

cases.technology: Replay transition claim with unresolved objection
cases.adjudication: The control critic leaves a critical transition objection unresolved.
Only one attested origin remains after review.

cases.technology: Replay candidate below the base admission gate
cases.adjudication: The deterministic base policy is not rank eligible.

cases.technology: Replay overbroad deployment claim narrowed to prototype
cases.adjudication: Attested evidence supports a narrower claim, not the original deployment scope.
No attested evidence is available for the claimed signal.
Two preserved origins support the claim; a material noncritical caveat does not invalidate it.
Two distinct critical objections are each resolved by new independently attested evidence.
Preserved prior evidence verifies a fatal chronology conflict.

cases.technology: Holdout novelty claim with unresolved chronology
cases.adjudication: A critical claim remains unknown and cannot be promoted.
Only non-primary provenance exists, so no qualifying attested evidence supports promotion.
Review roles cannot override a mature base-policy decision.

cases.technology: Holdout field-deployment claim narrowed to lab prototype
cases.adjudication: A cited corrected claim is valid while the original mechanism wording is not.

cases.technology: Holdout attractive claim without preserved evidence
cases.adjudication: A failed critical role makes the round incomplete and must HOLD.
